philosophy: Legal/info pages are reading-heavy. Maximize readability through generous whitespace, clear typographic hierarchy, and zero visual noise. Remove border-left headings in favor of pure typographic weight. Let space — not lines — separate sections.

LegalPages.layout: Single-column max-w-[680px] centered. Increase section spacing from space-y-10 to space-y-14 for stronger visual separation. Remove border-l-[3px] heading decorators — rely on font-size contrast alone (text-xl font-semibold vs text-sm body).
LegalPages.headingStyle: Replace border-l + pl-4 pattern with clean h2: text-xl font-semibold text-[#e6e8ee] tracking-tight mb-5. Section numbering in muted color as a small superscript-style label above heading for privacy/terms.
LegalPages.sectionCards: No cards for legal text sections. Only the medical disclaimer (terms article 2) retains a card treatment: rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-950/20 p-6. All other sections are open — separated by whitespace only.
LegalPages.bodyText: text-sm leading-[1.85] text-[#e6e8ee]/85. Increase line-height from leading-relaxed (1.625) to leading-[1.85] for dense legal paragraphs. Paragraph spacing mt-4 instead of mt-3.
LegalPages.lists: list-outside ml-4 instead of list-inside. Proper hanging indent for numbered/bulleted items. Space-y-3 for legal numbered lists.
LegalPages.links: text-[#1d9bf0] underline decoration-[#1d9bf0]/30 underline-offset-[3px] hover:decoration-[#1d9bf0]/70 transition-colors. Use accent blue instead of indigo to match design tokens.
LegalPages.lastUpdated: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-[#8b92a5] mb-12 — push further from title for breathing room.

tailwindClasses.pageWrapper: container mx-auto max-w-[680px] px-5 pb-24 pt-10 sm:pt-16
tailwindClasses.h1: mb-3 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#e6e8ee] sm:text-3xl
tailwindClasses.sectionNumber: block text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-[#8b92a5] mb-1.5

ContactPage.layout: Same max-w-[680px]. The email card becomes the visual anchor — single prominent card, rest is open text.
ContactPage.emailCard: rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.06] bg-[#1a1f2e] p-8. Larger padding for breathing room. Icon container: h-12 w-12 rounded-xl bg-[#1d9bf0]/10 with text-[#1d9bf0] icon.
ContactPage.emailButton: inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[#1d9bf0]/25 bg-[#1d9bf0]/10 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-[#1d9bf0] transition-all hover:bg-[#1d9bf0]/20 hover:border-[#1d9bf0]/40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#1d9bf0] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#0f1117]. Min tap target 44px achieved via py-3.
ContactPage.responseInfo: Use a subtle dl grid instead of bullet list for response time info: grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-4 gap-y-3. Label in text-[#8b92a5], value in text-[#e6e8ee]/90.

tailwindClasses.iconBox: flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#1d9bf0]/10 text-[#1d9bf0]
tailwindClasses.emailLink: inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[#1d9bf0]/25 bg-[#1d9bf0]/10 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-[#1d9bf0] transition-all hover:bg-[#1d9bf0]/20 hover:border-[#1d9bf0]/40

Breadcrumb.style: Keep minimal. Use a slash separator instead of ChevronRight icon — lighter visual weight. text-xs tracking-wide text-[#8b92a5]. Separator: mx-1.5 text-[#8b92a5]/40 select-none content '/'.
Breadcrumb.currentPage: text-[#e6e8ee]/60 — slightly dimmer than links to indicate non-interactive.
Breadcrumb.hoverState: hover:text-[#1d9bf0] transition-colors — use accent blue for consistency.

tailwindClasses.nav: mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-0 text-xs tracking-wide text-[#8b92a5]

AdPlaceholder.description: When ADSENSE_CLIENT is unset, render a visible placeholder instead of h-0 hidden div — useful during development and for layout testing. In production without ads, remain hidden.
AdPlaceholder.devPlaceholder: In development only (NODE_ENV === development): rounded-xl border border-dashed border-white/[0.08] bg-[#1a1f2e]/50 py-6 text-center text-xs text-[#8b92a5]/50. Shows '広告スペース' label.
AdPlaceholder.productionHidden: In production without adsense: h-0 overflow-hidden (current behavior, unchanged).
AdPlaceholder.withAds: Wrap ins element in a container with rounded-xl overflow-hidden for consistent corner radius with rest of UI.

tailwindClasses.devPlaceholder: rounded-xl border border-dashed border-white/[0.08] bg-[#1a1f2e]/50 py-6 text-center text-xs text-[#8b92a5]/50

accessibility: Accent #1d9bf0 on #0f1117 bg yields contrast ratio ~5.8:1 — passes WCAG AA
Text #e6e8ee on #0f1117 yields ~14.5:1 — passes WCAG AAA
Muted #8b92a5 on #0f1117 yields ~5.2:1 — passes WCAG AA for text
Email button min height 44px via py-3 + text-sm (tap target compliance)
Breadcrumb links have visible focus rings with ring-offset for dark bg
Medical disclaimer text-xs NOT reduced further — minimum font preserved per constraints
aria-current=page on breadcrumb current item for screen readers
All external links have rel=noopener noreferrer
keyChanges: Remove border-l heading decorators — use typographic hierarchy (size + weight) only
Increase section spacing to space-y-14 for cleaner visual separation
Switch link color from indigo-300 to #1d9bf0 accent for token consistency
Breadcrumb separator: ChevronRight icon -> slash character (lighter)
Increase body line-height to 1.85 for dense legal text readability
Contact email card: larger padding (p-8), accent blue instead of indigo
Legal list style: list-outside with proper hanging indent
AdBanner: visible dev placeholder, production behavior unchanged
